description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'PlaceholderFunctionTooComplexException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It is thrown when placeholder functions in a pipeline are too complex to execute safely. The class includes methods for creating, serializing, and deserializing the exception, as well as a builder for customization.

classes.name: PlaceholderFunctionTooComplexException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating placeholder functions are too complex in a pipeline.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: Mutable builder class for constructing instances of PlaceholderFunctionTooComplexException.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder with default message and description based on max allowed chained functions.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes the exception from a JSON object.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mutable builder initialized with current exception data.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with updated Ditto headers.
